How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

uv run server

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/Melikshah/dc_ops_env
cd dc_ops_env

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: Python 3.10+, uv or Docker.
